The run is the ordinary half of one class: dExtFrameCtrl_c's eight non-lifecycle methods (Copy, WillHitFrame, Finished, GetFlags, SetFlags, GetFrameCount, SetAnimation, Advance). dExtFrameCtrl_c is the tree's name for the ROM's dExtFrameCtrl_c root; notes/model-rtti-names.md recovers the family.

The run's ABI tail stays sharded: ~dExtFrameCtrl_c() is the key function, so a TU that defines it emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS under the coined '9Animation' spelling while the cartridge records spell '15dExtFrameCtrl_c'. A homeless emitted name resolves as a plain deadstrip, which the compiler-only policy refuses for RTTI/vtable records, so D2/D0/D1/C1/C2 (0x02015cb4..0x02015d38) keep their per-function sources until the class is renamed -- the licensed-range trim the daObjKuruma_c manifests already use.
LoadFile (0x0201794c) and UpdateFileOffsets (0x020469ac) are dExtFrameCtrl_c members too, but they link in other neighbourhoods and keep their own shards; they are not part of this run.

The neighbour before the run, _ZN15TextureSequenceC1Ev ending at 0x02015a7c, is a TextureSequence constructor; the ABI tail's own shards continue the run to 0x02015d38 where _ZN11ShadowModel9RenderAllEv begins. Neither is an dExtFrameCtrl_c method licensed here.
